The '''1946 [[Turkish Football Championship]]''' was the 12th edition of the competition. It was held in May. [[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]] won their second national championship title by winning the Final Group in [[Ankara]] undefeated.<ref>{{cite book|last=Yüce|first=Mehmet|title=İdmancı Ruhlar: Futbol Tarihimizin Klasik Devreleri (1923 - 1952)|issue=2|publisher=iletişim|pages=441|language=tr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.angelfire.com/nj/sivritepe/5758/TB.html|title=Türkiye Futbol Birinciliği|publisher=Erdinç Sivritepe|access-date=2 April 2018}}</ref>

The champions of the three major regional leagues ([[Istanbul Football League|Istanbul]], [[Ankara Football League|Ankara]], and [[İzmir Football League|İzmir]]) qualified directly for the Final Group. [[Eskişehir Demirspor]] qualified by winning the qualification play-off, which was contested by the winners of the regional qualification groups.
